profile.name: 无人车本地网页控制器
profile.name_en: Local Web Controller for Robotic Car
profile.description: 一种面向小型无人车或智能车实验的浏览器控制与监视终端，用于显示前视摄像头画面、发送转向和油门指令、切换驾驶模式，并支持校准和记录状态查看。
profile.description_en: A browser-based control and monitoring interface for small robotic or autonomous car experiments. It is used to display the forward camera view, send steering and throttle commands, switch drive modes, and support calibration and recording status display.
